criteria.name: Four value states survive compile
criteria.input: Compile a fixture station-month holding no record, null, blank, and a value carrying quality flag E
criteria.observation: The shared reader returns four distinguishable states with E attached only to the value day

criteria.name: Unrecognised manifest is refused
criteria.input: Hand-edit a valid store manifest to declare an unknown format version, then query it
criteria.observation: The reader refuses and names the rebuild command; no download or partial interpretation occurs

criteria.name: Native values are unchanged on disk
criteria.input: Compile a fixture publishing 12.4 in the source unit
criteria.observation: The store holds 12.4 in that unit and conversion occurs only in the returned frame

criteria.name: Undeclared source column stops the compile
criteria.input: Compile an artifact with a source column absent from the layout declaration
criteria.observation: Compilation refuses; no staged store is published; the prior store and artifact remain

criteria.name: No plausible prefix is published
criteria.input: Compile an artifact with a truncated 1997 member followed by valid 1998 records
criteria.observation: No store is published and no 1998 row is readable

criteria.name: Verification catches a mutated store
criteria.input: Alter one staged value after writing and before verification
criteria.observation: Read-back fails, atomic replacement does not occur, and the artifact remains

depends_on.reason: read-back calls the shared reader's query path

criteria.name: A value names the release it came from
criteria.input: Fetch any ca_eccc value from a compiled store
criteria.observation: Provenance carries source vintage and publisher-artifact checksum

depends_on.reason: the compile deletes the publisher artifact; the store becomes the only copy

criteria.name: Two unlike sources read through one path
criteria.input: Compile HYDAT SQLite and Poland yearly ZIP archives, then fetch one station-year from each
criteria.observation: The shared reader serves both with no provider branch or provider code on retrieval

depends_on.reason: Poland's compile deletes its artifacts too
Poland falsifies the layout; a defect found here invalidates Canada's stores

criteria.name: The gigabyte never lands unasked
criteria.input: Fetch a ca_eccc station with no local store
criteria.observation: An issue names the download command; cache remains empty; no request reaches the host

criteria.name: Insufficient disk refuses before downloading
criteria.input: Invoke ca_eccc download with reported free space below the compile requirement
criteria.observation: It refuses before download and names required and available space

depends_on.reason: cache_status reads the provider's store declaration from CacheConfig

criteria.name: A receipt declares its authorship
criteria.input: Fetch ca_eccc and usgs_nwis values with receipt retention requested
criteria.observation: The store excerpt carries store/query/format/vintage facts and publisher payload holds untouched bytes

depends_on.reason: the store_excerpt receipt is built from the reader's executed query and manifest facts

criteria.name: Legacy retirement and governing documents agree
criteria.input: Inspect the legacy provider subtrees, public documentation, and ADR status/count statements after both ports and public surfaces land
criteria.observation: Both legacy subtrees are absent and documentation names the final receipts and bulk surfaces with ADRs 0021-0023 accepted

depends_on.reason: deleting the legacy subtree requires the port to have removed its references
the receipts name must be final before it is documented
